factValues.name: gr:t20_fv
factValues.value: The financial statements have been prepared and delivered in accordance with the provisions of Part 15 of the Companies Act 2006 relating to small companies.

factValues.name: gr:t21_fv
factValues.value: In accordance with Section 444 of the Companies Act 2006, the Income Statement has not been delivered.

factValues.name: gr:t22_fv
factValues.value: The accounts have been prepared in accordance with the provisions of FRS 102 Section 1A small entities. There were no material departures from that standard.

factValues.name: gr:t23_fv
factValues.value: The financial statements have been prepared under the historic cost convention,except that as disclosed in the accounting policies, certain items are shown at fair value. The presentational currency is in sterling which has been rounded to the nearest £1.

factValues.name: gr:t24_fv
factValues.value: Turnover Turnover comprises the fair value of the consideration received or receivable for the sale of goods and provision of services in the course of the company's activities and is shown net of sales/value added tax, returns, rebates and discounts. Income is recognised when goods/services have been delivered/provided to clients should that risk and rewards of ownership have transferred to them.

factValues.name: gr:t25_fv
factValues.value: Stocks Stock has been valued at the lower of cost and estimated selling price less costs to sell.

factValues.name: gr:t26_fv
factValues.value: Foreign currency Transactions in foreign currency are recorded at the rate ruling at the date of the transaction. Monetary assets and liabilities denominated in foreign currencies are retranslated at the rate of exchange ruling at the balance sheet date. All differences are taken to the profit and loss account.

factValues.name: gr:t27_fv
factValues.value: Pension costs The company operates a defined contribution pension scheme and the pension cost charge represents the contributions payable by the company to the fund in respect of the period. The assets of the scheme are held separately from those of the company in an independently administered fund.

factValues.name: gr:t28_fv
factValues.value: Deferred taxation Deferred Taxation is provided on the liability method to take account of timing differences between treatment of certain items for accounts purposes and their treatment for tax. Tax deferred or accelerated is accounted for in respect of all material timing differences.
